summary: NLCS Game 3, Brewers up 2-0: Snell's recent outings have been short and wild, and both managers have rested bullpens ready to take over early.

legs.note: Milwaukee's bullpen has 9 2/3 scoreless NLCS innings and had an off day, while the Dodgers used seven relievers in Game 2. The Brewers cover if they win or lose by one.

extra_legs.note: Snell got just 12 and 11 outs in his last two starts and walked 5 Braves in the NLDS. Milwaukee led the majors in walk rate and has 11 walks this series, which runs up pitch counts.
extra_legs.status: Healthy. Only 42 2/3 regular-season innings, so his workload is limited

extra_legs.note: His last three outings ended with 1, 3 and 5 strikeouts as his starts got shorter. He needs 6 strikeouts, which means pitching deep into the game.
Milwaukee pulled him after 4 innings and 56 pitches in the NLDS, and its bullpen is rested. He has a 5.91 ERA in two career starts against the Dodgers.
